method: Original Arabic patient-facing synthesis. AAPM&R PM&R KnowledgeNOW defines specialty coverage; current independent clinical practice guidelines, consensus statements, systematic reviews and high-quality trials verify management, uncertainty and escalation messages.
rights_note: No AAPM&R patient handout, copyrighted wording, figure, table or image is reproduced or translated. Sources are linked and attributed; Arabic content is independently written.
